summary:
Implemented the Maintenance follow-up slice.

Added `maintenance.html#service-followup`, with iPhone-friendly oil, wheel/tire, battery, and filter recheck notes. A saved Service Closeout now preselects the matching follow-up, carries mileage forward, and supports Copy, Share, and Save into existing Garage Notes. The Maintenance bottom bar now includes `Follow`.

Verified:
`Invoke-BrowserSmoke.ps1 -Pages @('maintenance.html')`
`Test-InternalLinks.ps1`
`Invoke-SiteAudit.ps1 -Pages @('maintenance.html') -Tag audit-v380-maintenance-followup -SkipScreenshots`
`Invoke-BrowserSmoke.ps1 -Pages @('index.html')`

Next safe slice: real-iPhone review of this Follow-Up note after an actual service, or rotate to Home/Anton clarity or fuse/reference recovery.

Impact Score: 4/5
Visible Change: Maintenance now has a Follow-Up note for post-service rechecks.
Impact Reason: It makes the iPhone service workflow more useful after the job is done, not just before logging it.
